subject.declared_domain: the estate OBJECT write-freshness and hygiene surface -- advisory-only, read-only, distinct from comp-freshness which covers data pipelines

methodology.evidence: --help read at HEAD: 5 subcommands (freshness, drift, score, federated, compare), self-described as 'Estate OBJECT write-freshness + hygiene (NFRA_HEATMAP_OBJECT). ADVISORY-ONLY, read-only.' Executable at .tools/comp-heat, 19,267 bytes, 2026-08-04.
methodology.how: A read-only advisory surface over git write-times and, in the federated mode, over estate assets joined to git code-heat. It COMPOSES git history and the estate asset set; it INVENTS the hot/warm/cold banding and the exponential recency score.
declared_opinions: the band barriers hot<=7d, warm<=30d, cold>30d -- chosen cutoffs, printed on every run
a 30-day half-life in the recency score
that write-time is a proxy for relevance at all, which is the tool's founding opinion

cadence.evidence: No schedule: an on-demand CLI. Every run computes from git state at call time. live_matches_declared is not_applicable because no rhythm is declared.

persistence.evidence: The tool persists nothing: `freshness` and `score` compute and print. PERSISTED FALSE IS MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED -- I ran both subcommands and no artifact appeared; the output is stdout only. (federated mode reads a live Trino federation, which I did not run.)

location.evidence: Executable resolved at .tools/comp-heat and exercised from there.

co_resident_stores.note: the invoke-cold sibling named in the SAME wave-1 string that produced this subject

coverage.evidence: ⛔ COVERAGE IS SCOPED TO WHAT I EXERCISED, AND THE DENOMINATOR SAYS SO: 3 of 5 subcommands were exercised (score, freshness, drift). `federated` was NOT run -- it requires a LIVE Trino federation. `compare` was NOT run. So this card's failure-mode row speaks for 3 of 5 surfaces and is silent about 2, rather than generalising from the 3 I happened to reach. Within `freshness` on org/modules/graph: 425 files scanned, bands hot=29 warm=58 cold=338, cold_frac 0.80.
explicitly_out: federated -- needs a live Trino federation, not run

key.evidence: `freshness` keys on repo-root-relative PATHS (its own error text says so). `score` takes an arbitrary `id` string and, as measured below, never resolves it -- so for `score` the id is not an identity at all. crosses_spaces is TRUE because `federated` declares a join between estate ASSETS and git CODE-heat, two different id spaces, and no mapping between them is declared anywhere I could find.
key.identity_space: repo-root-relative path for freshness; an unresolved free string for score
key.key_expression: for the freshness surface a member's key is its repo-root-relative path (.tools/<tool>); the score surface's key is an unresolved free string and is NOT expressed here

failure_mode.evidence: EXERCISED per subcommand, with arms reachable from different truths. ⛔ `score` IS A PURE FUNCTION OF --age-days AND NEVER RESOLVES ITS id. Four ids at --age-days 30 -- 'zzz/nonexistent/qqq.py', a real repo path, 'data/firm_registry.json', and the literal '!!!not even a path!!!' -- ALL returned score=0.5000 band=WARM. Varying --age-days on a FIXED real id moved it (7d->0.8507 HOT, 30d->0.5000 WARM, 90d->0.1250 COLD), so the discriminator is the flag and the id is echoed only. A garbage id yields a confident, well-formed band. ⚠ MY FIRST ATTEMPT AT THIS TEST WAS INVALID and I discarded it: both arms failed on a missing required --age-days, so they collapsed onto one truth and the identical output said nothing about miss-vs-hit. The result above is the re-run with both arms reachable. BY CONTRAST `freshness` RESOLVES: a nonexistent path returns 'comp-heat freshness: no tracked/untracked files under zzz/nonexistent/qqq/' while a real path returns a full band report -- loud and distinguishable. `drift` takes no positional target (rc=2 on both arms), so the miss-vs-hit question does not apply to it and I make no claim there.
failure_mode.returns_on_failure: score: a confident band+score computed from --age-days alone, id unresolved. freshness: an explicit no-files-found message. drift: takes no target.
silent_degrade_paths: score accepts any id and returns a well-formed band, so a caller passing a wrong or stale id gets a plausible answer about nothing

verdict.why: An advisory, read-only, stateless tool that persists nothing and whose `freshness` surface fails loudly and correctly. QUALIFIED on one measured behaviour: `score` never resolves its id, so it will return a confident WARM/0.5000 for a string that is not a path at all. That is arguably by design for a calculator taking --age-days as input, and this card does not call it a defect -- but a consumer passing a resolved-from-elsewhere id would reasonably believe the score is ABOUT that object, and it is not.
